story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Keep it going. I have a question that was asked by a friend of mine, his name is Leonard Brown, he teaches up at Northeastern University and this will be the 26th year
that he’s held the annual John Coltrane Memorial Concert. And he said, “Anthony could you ask Elvin, ‘What does music mean to him?’”
So this is slating take five of the Elvin Jones interview. So Elvin, I asked on the previous tape, what does music mean to you?
It means that you are, well since you asked me directly, it means that I am doing the work that I was born to do. That’s why I’m here. There’s no other reason.
